mentions.name: AppTela
mentions.description: A macOS app launcher that lets users organize apps across screens, categories, groups, and stacks. Features visual stacks that pile apps on top of each other, launch stacks that open a whole set of apps at once, and a shadow engine where icons cast shadows based on the time of day. Available on the Mac App Store.
mentions.problem: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS Tahoe and the built-in replacement is pretty bare.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a macOS app launcher called AppTela (https://apptela.com). Apple removed Launchpad in Tahoe and the replacement is pretty bare, so I built something with more depth and honestly better than most alternatives out there (IMHO). You can organise apps across screens, categories, groups and stacks.
